title: Community
description: Suggestions, bugs, referrals and anonymous messages in {guild}, each system turns on and off on its own.
underConstruction: Under construction, settings for this system are coming soon.

suggestions.label: Suggestions
suggestions.hint: Ideas channel with 👍/👎 voting and staff triage.

bugs.label: Bugs
bugs.hint: Configurable form, severity, assignee and triage queue.

referrals.label: Referrals
referrals.hint: Who brought whom, leaderboard and rewards for invite milestones.

anonymous.label: Anonymous
anonymous.hint: Public confessions and a direct line to the staff, with auditing.

staff.label: Staff application
staff.hint: Applications to join the staff, with a review queue and a reply by DM.

fields.title: Form questions
fields.pages: {pages, plural, =1 {one screen} other {# screens in sequence}}
fields.proHint: (Pro unlocks up to 5, the Discord ceiling)
fields.empty: Without questions, nobody can submit. Add at least one.
fields.labelPlaceholder: Question (e.g. Why do you want to join the team?)
fields.rangeInvalid: The minimum is greater than the maximum, nobody can answer.
fields.ceilingHint: Discord accepts up to {ceiling} characters in {type, select, long {long text} other {short text}}. The minimum is enforced on submit.
fields.discordLimit: Discord limit reached: a modal accepts at most 5 fields.

queue.needsReason: This change requires a reason, use the ⚙️ Triage menu in Discord.
queue.openSummary: {count} open · sorted by severity, oldest first, the order a triage actually works in.
queue.repostHint: Deletes the current message and publishes a new one in its place; the new one appears at the end of the channel and the old link stops working. The report and its triage stay intact.
queue.publishHint: This report has no card in the channel. Publishing gives the team back the triage buttons inside Discord.
queue.reasonHint: Fixed, duplicate and “not a bug” require a reason and are set through the ⚙️ menu in Discord.

errors.channel: Choose the channel where reports will be posted.
errors.noFields: Add at least one field to the form.

enabled.label: Bug reports
enabled.description: Structured form, severity and triage queue.

channels.title: Channels
channels.label: Reports channel
channels.forumPro: This channel is a forum, but forum mode is Pro, so reports will be posted as regular messages, without tags. Nothing breaks.

panel.title: Submission panel
panel.description: Pinned message with the report button. Without a panel, members use /reportar.
panel.defaultContent:
## 🐛 Report a bug

Found a problem on the server? Click the button below and describe what happened; the team follows every report through triage.

form.description: The questions a member answers when opening a report.

triage.title: Triage
triage.description: Default severity, who triages, on-call for critical and notifications.
triage.notifyPlaceholder: Pinged once when the report is critical
triage.notifyHint: Pinged only the first time: lowering the severity and raising it again does not notify again.
triage.threads: Open a discussion thread on each report
triage.archive: Archive the thread when the report is closed
triage.dm: Notify the reporter on every change
triage.dmAssigneePlaceholder: Hi '{membro}'! Your report #'{numero}' · '{titulo}' was assigned to '{responsavel}'.
triage.dmHint: Here the notice is automatic, with no modal: a report changes state several times along the way, and writing at every step would make the team stop updating the state, which is exactly what keeps the reporter informed. Empty uses the default text. Placeholders: '{membro}', '{numero}', '{titulo}', '{estado}', '{responsavel}' and '{nota}'.

customize.label: Customize the content
customize.description: When off, the panel uses a default text. The button is added automatically either way.

common.republishHint: Already published; republishing deletes the previous message.

antispam.title: Anti-spam
antispam.description: Zero turns the rule off. Enforced on the server, not the client.

ON_APPROVE.label: On approval
ON_APPROVE.hint: Discussion happens only on what will be done.

ON_POST.label: On every suggestion
ON_POST.hint: Creates a thread on submission; on a busy server it becomes a flood.

errors.channel: Choose the channel where suggestions will be posted.

enabled.label: Suggestion system
enabled.description: Members submit ideas, the community votes and the team decides.

channels.description: Where cards appear and, optionally, where approved ones are reposted.
channels.postPlaceholder: Choose the channel where cards appear

panel.description: Pinned message with the submit suggestion button. Without a panel, members use /sugerir.
panel.defaultContent:
## 💡 Suggestions

Got an idea for the server? Click the button below, write your proposal and the community votes.

voting.title: Voting
voting.description: Who can vote and what happens after the decision.
voting.afterDecisionHint: When off, the card freezes the final count, which stays visible.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.description: Approval queue, staff roles and author notification.
moderation.requireApprovalHint: The suggestion {strong} when submitted: it waits in the queue for someone to release it in the panel. With no card in Discord, the ⚙️ Manage menu does not exist either, so all triage happens in the panel. When off, it appears in the channel and goes to a vote right away.
moderation.requireApprovalStrong: does not go to the channel
moderation.staffPlaceholder: Who can approve, reject and mark as duplicate
moderation.dm: Notify the author by DM on decision
moderation.dmApprovedPlaceholder: Hi '{membro}'! Your suggestion #'{numero}' · '{titulo}' was approved, thanks for helping improve the server.
moderation.dmImplementedPlaceholder: Hi '{membro}'! Your suggestion #'{numero}' · '{titulo}' was implemented and is already live.
moderation.dmHint: They open prefilled when deciding, in the panel and in the Discord ⚙️ menu, and the team edits them before sending. Empty here uses the default text; clearing it at decision time notifies no one. Placeholders: '{membro}', '{numero}', '{titulo}' and '{motivo}'. Rejections and duplicates keep the short automatic notice, which already includes the reason.

discussion.title: Discussion
discussion.description: When to open a discussion thread on the suggestion.

antispam.description: Zero turns the rule off. Limits are enforced on the server, not the client.

queue.published: Published in the channel, voting is open.
queue.reasonRequired: Write the reason; it goes to the author and to the card in Discord.
queue.heldHint: The approval queue held this suggestion. Publishing opens voting; it stays pending until the team decides.
queue.decidedUnpostedHint: This suggestion was decided without ever going to the channel. Publishing posts the card with its current state and enables the ⚙️ Manage menu in Discord.
queue.repostHint: Deletes the current message and publishes a new one in its place. The new one appears at the {end}, the old link stops working{hasThread, select, yes { and the {thread}, since it hangs off the message being deleted} other {}}. Votes already cast are kept: they live in the database, not in the message.
queue.reasonPlaceholder: Reason (required when rejecting), goes to the author and the card.
queue.duplicateHint: Marking as duplicate requires the original’s number; use the ⚙️ Manage menu in Discord.
queue.alreadyDecided: Already decided. Reopening a closed suggestion is done in Discord.

reason.no_permission: Bot lacks the Manage Server permission
reason.ambiguous: More than one invite changed at the same time
reason.vanity_or_unknown: Vanity URL, OAuth or expired invite

queue.inviterRequired: Enter the Discord ID of the inviter.

noPermission.title: The bot is missing the {permission} permission
noPermission.body: Without it the bot cannot list the server invites, so no join is attributed to the inviter and the counter stays at zero even with people joining through the link. Give the permission to the bot role and new joins start counting; older ones you attribute by hand here.

queue.summary: {count, plural, one {# join recorded} other {# joins recorded}} · every join is stored, attributed or not. The inviter’s counter goes up right away; the reward only after the quarantine.
queue.accountAge: {count, plural, one {account # day old} other {account # days old}}
queue.attributeHint: Attribute it by hand if you know who invited.

grants.title: Milestones delivered
grants.hint: A failed delivery is not retried automatically, since a milestone is granted only once. Use resend; giving a role the member already has is harmless.
grants.errors: {count, plural, one {# delivery} other {# deliveries}} with a recorded error.

milestones.rewardRequired: Choose at least one reward: role, channel or in-game action.
milestones.removeTitle: Remove the {count, plural, one {# invite} other {# invites}} milestone?
milestones.removeDescription: Whoever already got the reward keeps it; removing the milestone only stops new grants.
milestones.title: Reward milestones
milestones.description: When the number of confirmed invites is reached, the member gets the reward automatically, only once per milestone.
milestones.channelPlaceholder: Optional, unlocks the channel for whoever reaches it
milestones.pendingLinkHint: If the member has not linked their game account yet, the delivery stays pending and happens as soon as they link it, within 24h.
milestones.announce: Announce in the referrals announcement channel

reason.ambiguous: two people joined at the same time
reason.no_permission: the bot has no permission to see invites

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.description: How long the invited member must stay on the server before the invite counts. This is what stops join-and-leave farming.

leaderboard.hint: A pinned message with the top ten referrers. The bot edits it on its own when the numbers change, including when the quarantine ends.

tools.recomputed: Counters recalculated for {count, plural, one {# inviter} other {# inviters}}.
tools.seasonDescription: The leaderboard goes back to zero for everyone. The join history is kept; nothing is deleted.
tools.title: Tools
tools.hint: Recalculating rebuilds the numbers from the recorded joins, useful if something looks off. Manual adjustments are kept.

enabled.label: Referral system
enabled.description: Tracks who brought whom, with a leaderboard and farm protection.

protection.title: Farm protection
protection.description: Account age, daily cap, returning members and verification role.
protection.minAgeHint: Accounts newer than this do not count as invites.
protection.ignoreRejoinsHint: Stops leave-and-rejoin farming. Returning members count again for the original inviter.
protection.verifiedRoleHint: The referral only counts after the invited member gets this role. Until then it stays pending, not rejected, so anyone who verifies later still counts.

channels.description: A single channel for the system announcements: member joins and milestones reached.
channels.announcePlaceholder: Where to announce joins and milestones
channels.announceHint: Without a channel nothing is announced, even with the notice turned on.
channels.announceJoinsHint: For every member who joins, the bot posts who invited them, which invite was used and how many people have joined through it. Joins with no identified invite are posted too, with the reason, so staff can attribute them by hand.

unattributed.title: Joins without an inviter
unattributed.hint: Not every join can be attributed. The reason is recorded; it is not a silent gap.

panic.confirmDescription: Turns the system off and DELETES the panel message. Use it during a raid; nothing is lost, and you can turn it back on whenever you want.
panic.done: System turned off and panel removed.
panic.title: Emergency stop
panic.description: Turns the system off {strong}. During a raid, leaving the button up while the server refuses only creates a queue of attempts and people thinking the bot broke. Nothing is lost.
panic.button: Turn off and remove the panel

disclosure.title: It is pseudonymity, not anonymity.
disclosure.memberSees: The member sees exactly this before writing: “{disclosure}”
disclosure.controller: You are the {controller} of this data (LGPD); MRI is the processor. The identity is deleted automatically after {days} days.

enabled.label: System active
enabled.hint: Turning it off here deletes nothing; it just stops accepting new messages.

modes.title: Modes
modes.description: Public confessions and the direct line to staff turn on and off separately.
modes.confessionsHint: The message is posted in a channel without the writer’s name.
modes.staffLineHint: Private report: opens a thread only staff can see, and the reply goes by DM.

panel.description: Pinned message with one button per enabled mode. Without a panel, members use /anonimo.
panel.noModes: No mode is on, so the panel would have no buttons. Turn on public confessions or the staff line in "Modes".
panel.defaultContent:
## 🎭 Anonymous message

Choose below how you want to talk to the server.
panel.customizeHint: When off, the panel uses a default text that already includes the pseudonymity notice. The buttons are added automatically.
panel.disclosureKept: The notice “{disclosure}” still shows in the form even if you do not write it here; it is mandatory and always in the member’s way.
panel.saveFirst: Save before publishing; the buttons come from the saved modes.
panel.modesBlocked: Save "Modes" first: the panel is built from the enabled modes.

audit.title: Audit and retention
audit.description: Where the trail is kept and for how long the identity is stored.
audit.failClosed: If set and the bot {not} post in it, the message {notPublished}. This is on purpose: an anonymous post with no trail cannot be undone.
audit.includeIdentity: Show the identity in the audit channel
audit.includeIdentityHint: When off, the channel only says there was a message; the name stays only here in the panel, where retention applies.
audit.retention: Keep identity for (days), your plan allows up to {max}
audit.retentionHint: After this period, the name and original text are deleted and the message stays without an author. Minimum of 30 days: below that, the evidence against an abuser disappears before the report is investigated.

review.description: What waits for staff approval before going live.
review.hint: Held messages show up in the {tab} tab, where staff approve or discard them one by one.
review.proHint: Holding messages is a Pro feature.
review.proTitle: The review queue is a Pro feature
review.proBody: Hold every message for manual approval before publishing. The automatic abuse controls (new account, cooldown, links, invites, blocked words) keep working on the free plan.

abuse.title: Abuse controls
abuse.description: All included in the free plan; safety controls behind a paywall make no sense.
abuse.stripLinksHint: Server invites are always refused, regardless of this option.

history.identityHidden: Author identities are not shown: either you lack the “View anonymous message author” permission, or the retention period has passed.

errors.focusGone: This application is no longer available; it may have been deleted by retention.

errors.title: The position needs a title.
errors.noQuestions: An open position with no questions opens no form at all.

postings.title: Positions
postings.summary: {count, plural, one {# open} other {# open}}{hasMax, select, yes { of {max} on your plan} other {}}. The panel shows one button per open position, and each position has its own form.
postings.limit: You reached your plan’s limit of open positions. Close one to open another.
postings.titleHint: Becomes the button label on the panel and the title of the form screens.
postings.planLimit: Plan limit reached: {max} questions per position.
postings.planHint: Your plan allows {max} questions per position; Pro unlocks up to 15, answered in up to 3 screens.
postings.pagesHint: Above {limit} questions the applicant answers in successive screens: each one is a Discord form, and nothing is sent until the last. Long forms cause half-finished applications; ask only what the team will read.

queue.reposted: Card reposted in the staff channel.
queue.dmFailed: Decision recorded, but the DM was not delivered: {error}
queue.roleFailed: Decision recorded, but the role was not applied: {error}

card.title: Card in the staff channel
card.repostHint: Reposting deletes the current message and publishes a new one at the end of the channel. The application and decision stay intact.
card.publishHint: This application has no card in the channel; publishing gives the team back the decision buttons inside Discord.

queue.dmHint: Comes prefilled with the default text for {state}. Edit freely; clearing it all decides without notifying anyone.
queue.noteLabel: Internal reason (not sent to the applicant)
queue.rejectHint: Rejecting does not lock the person out: after the interval between applications, they can apply to this position again.
queue.alreadyDecided: Already decided{notified, select, yes { · applicant notified} other {}}.

enabled.label: Staff applications
enabled.description: A form per position, review queue and private feedback.

panel.title: Application panel
panel.description: Pinned message with one button per open position.
panel.defaultContent:
## 📋 Staff application

Want to join the team? Click the position below and fill in the form. The team reviews it and gets back to you in private.
panel.customizeHint: When off, the panel uses a default text. The position buttons are added automatically either way.
panel.publishHint: The panel is built from the saved settings, including the positions open right now.

review.title: Notice and role
review.description: Where staff are notified and what the applicant gets when approved.
review.channelPlaceholder: Gets only the summary, never the answers
review.channelHint: Answers stay only in this queue. Sending the whole form to Discord would turn a channel permission mistake into a personal data leak.
review.approvedRoleFree: On the current plan the role is not applied automatically; staff must give it by hand after approving.

eligibility.title: Who can apply
eligibility.cooldownHint: It is also how long a rejected person waits to try the same position again, counted from the decision.
eligibility.requiredRolePlaceholder: Only members with this role see the form

feedback.title: Applicant feedback
feedback.description: The text that comes prefilled when deciding.
feedback.approvalPlaceholder: Hi '{membro}'! You were approved for '{vaga}'. Reach out to us to arrange the next steps.
feedback.rejectionPlaceholder: Hi '{membro}', thanks for applying for '{vaga}'. We are not moving forward with your application this time, but keep an eye out for future openings.
feedback.reviewPlaceholder: Hi '{membro}'! Your application for '{vaga}' is under review; we will get back to you soon.
feedback.hint: Each text opens prefilled in the decision modal, in the panel and on the card buttons in Discord. Staff edit it before sending; leaving it empty decides without notifying anyone. Placeholders: '{membro}' and '{vaga}'. Who decided shows on the staff card and {never} in the applicant’s message.

retention.title: Retention
retention.description: Applications are personal data and do not disappear on their own.
retention.hint: The purge deletes only {decided} applications; a stalled queue is not expired data, it is overdue work.
